policy: A gate passes only when its evidence record is explicitly marked pass and bound to the exact current runtime and GLB SHA-256 values.

stowed_silhouette_reviewed.evidence: Exact 1.0.3 GLB rendered stowed at both breakpoints with the upgraded console, nested guards, selection self-test pass and zero runtime errors on 2026-08-25.

platform_controls_visual_reviewed.method: Official PVC 2404 figure comparison plus local desktop and mobile browser close review
platform_controls_visual_reviewed.evidence: The inward-facing removable station visibly includes the molded carrier, operator-facing phone cradle, integrated symbol-and-status legend with battery bars, joystick boot, grip, rocker and trigger, mushroom E-stop, selectors, alarm, USB, warning and capacity lenses, hardware and standard relaxed harness. raised_pose_browser_reviewed.evidence: Full lift plus 0.55 m extension rendered continuously with dynamic bounds framing, selection self-test pass, zero runtime errors, 60 fps and 17.7 ms p95 on 2026-08-25.

extension_browser_reviewed.method: Local browser full-extension review plus exported six-pair mesh-bound gates
extension_browser_reviewed.evidence: Fixed outer and moving inner rails and toe boards retain 0.568 m, 0.293 m and 0.018 m overlap at 0, 50 and 100 percent travel with 3-4 mm lateral clearance and no guard opening.

steering_boundary_reviewed.method: Static manual contract, numerical presentation-route validator and local browser review
steering_boundary_reviewed.evidence: Manual steering remains bounded to the verified 80 mm cylinder presentation with unsupported spindle response neutral. The explicitly reconstructed showcase path separately uses 1.07 m wheelbase and 0.67 m track Ackermann geometry, with maximum sampled visual steer 0.570 rad below its 0.58 rad cap.

figure_eight_presentation_reviewed.method: 2400-sample numerical route validator plus desktop and 390x844 browser exercise
figure_eight_presentation_reviewed.evidence: The 8.2 by 6.0 coefficient Gerono path closes, crosses center with finite tangent, holds approximately 0.72 m/s, remains inside the reconstructed steering envelope without clamp scrub, integrates four path-radius wheel speeds against the authored 0.13 m radius, remains within a 12 m presentation floor, stays stowed, follows with the camera, and supports pause, resume and manual takeover. UI identifies all route steering and wheel motion as reconstructed visualization, not ES1930M autonomy.

mobile_drag_direction_reviewed.method: Deterministic pointer-type direction validator, exact 600S camera-basis equivalence and 390x844 layout review
mobile_drag_direction_reviewed.evidence: Touch right and down deltas now match the 600S flagship orbit despite the ES camera's different spherical basis; mouse behavior remains unchanged. This is synthetic projected-camera proof, not a physical-device claim.

accessibility_reviewed.method: Keyboard dialog review plus native route-control semantics inspection
accessibility_reviewed.evidence: About focused the close button, Escape closed the modal and restored the About opener. The aria-live mode changes only on state transitions, the toggle exposes pressed state, pause becomes Resume path with Route paused status, reduced motion locks travel, and native slider input cancels the route.

desktop_browser_zero_errors.method: Local in-app browser diagnostics and console inspection
desktop_browser_zero_errors.evidence: Exact 1.0.3 GLB loaded with runtime error count zero, no console warnings or errors and stable 60 fps sampling.

mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.method: 390x844 collapsed and expanded browser review plus deterministic gesture validator
mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.evidence: The control panel and route card fit both mobile states. Five pinch cases prove monotonic zoom and clamps; touch direction matches the flagship camera basis while mouse direction remains preserved. No physical touchscreen claim is made.

selection_and_focus_reviewed.method: Three-state rig self-test plus local platform focus
selection_and_focus_reviewed.evidence: Dynamic interaction volumes passed self-test; Platform focus framed the upgraded controller and safely canceled and reset the presentation route.

performance_reviewed.evidence: The 407-node, 282-mesh, 35,344-triangle exact GLB held 60 fps with observed p95 17.7-18.4 ms while stowed, raised and following the route.

deployed_pages_reviewed.evidence: Pages run 32920385093 deployed commit 5597b09d00b70ea086132cbbef0f386fdaefe7f6 successfully. Public ES1930M HTML, runtime.js, presentation-route.mjs and GLB matched local SHA-256 byte-for-byte; the live GLB passed selection self-test, ran the four-wheel figure-eight at 60 fps, and reported zero runtime or console errors on 2026-08-25.
